name: app-orange-black-cream-widget-tile-set-on-grey-carousel-cover
title: Orange, Black and Cream Widget Tile Set
whatItIs: A pale grey board with a 3-by-3 grid of rounded widget tiles: a cappuccino product card, a charging gauge, a book page, a calorie burn gauge, a wide orange Bank wallet card with a headline, a lime 65% performance tile, a map route tile and a line chart tile, with a handle and swipe cue.
whatItMeans: A mixed set of squares in orange, black and cream with a lime pop shows a versatile widget system in one language.
techniques: Lime used once for a performance tile
One wide tile spanning two columns
3D and embossed touches on icons and lettering

vocabulary.definition: A small rounded square showing one piece of information.
Text that looks pressed into or raised from a surface.
A small prompt for the next carousel slide.
